query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversations` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user1Id` int NOT NULL,
  `user2Id` int NOT NULL,
  `lastMessageAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `lastMessagePreview` varchar(255),
  `user1UnreadCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `user2UnreadCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `conv_user1_idx` (`user1Id`),
  INDEX `conv_user2_idx` (`user2Id`),
  INDEX `conv_unique` (`user1Id`, `user2Id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `messages` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversationId` int NOT NULL,
  `senderId` int NOT NULL,
  `receiverId` int NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `isRead` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `readAt` timestamp NULL,
  `attachedTrackId` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `msg_conv_id_idx` (`conversationId`),
  INDEX `msg_sender_idx` (`senderId`),
  INDEX `msg_receiver_idx` (`receiverId`),
  INDEX `msg_created_at_idx` (`createdAt`)
);
